stages.title: Stage 1
stages.task: Talk to Yansur at the base of the Qira Hive to start the quest
hints: Each division has nine floors and a Division Leader. To pass a floor, defeat the monsters and put the five catalysts they drop into the collector; the Division Leader drops the single catalyst you need.

stages.title: Stage 2
stages.task: Clear the Thunder Division, defeat the Psychomancer, then talk to Yansur for a Thunder Voucher
hints: Take each voucher to the shop at the base of the Hive and talk to the servant there.

stages.title: Stage 3
stages.task: Clear the Air Division, defeat Gale, then talk to Yansur for an Air Voucher

stages.title: Stage 4
stages.task: Clear the Earth Division, defeat Genesis, then talk to Yansur for an Earth Voucher

stages.title: Stage 5
stages.task: Clear the Water Division, defeat the Oceanic Judge, then talk to Yansur for a Water Voucher

stages.title: Stage 6
stages.task: Clear the Fire Division, defeat the Solar Vanguard, then talk to Yansur for a Fire Voucher

stages.title: Stage 7
stages.task: Clear the Master Division and defeat Qira

stages.title: Stage 8
stages.task: Talk to Yansur to finish the quest

stages.title: Stage 1
stages.task: Talk to Ankou at the Tower of Ascension to start the quest
hints: The tower has 7 floors of ten levels each: nine regular levels and one boss level. A regular level needs five tokens from its challenge, a boss level one token.

stages.title: Stage 2
stages.task: Begin each floor, collect 5 tokens on each level and hand them to the Floor Master
hints: This repeats for the nine regular levels of every floor.

stages.title: Stage 3
stages.task: Collect the boss token on level 10 of each floor and hand it to the Floor Master
hints: After a whole floor you return to Ankou and can begin the next one.

stages.title: Stage 4
stages.task: Clear all 7 floors, then talk to Ankou to finish the quest

stages.title: Stage 1
stages.task: Talk to the Computer in Gavel and visit the Blue, Red and Yellow Meteors
hints: Each meteor has its own puzzle; the wiki page lists every solution.

stages.title: Stage 2
stages.task: Gather the required items and solve the puzzles of Lab Y (Yahya's House)

stages.title: Stage 3
stages.task: Solve the puzzles of Lab N (The Checkpoint)

stages.title: Stage 4
stages.task: Finish at Lab M (the White Meteor)

stages.title: Stage 1
stages.task: Talk to Caras at [1077, 84, -1613]

stages.title: Stage 2
stages.task: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian

stages.title: Stage 3
stages.task: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
hints: The Eagle Totem is hidden in a cave starting at [1115, 83, -1608]. At the end of the cave, you can fight a miniboss which will drop the totem.
names: The Eagle Totem is hidden in a cave star

stages.title: Stage 4
stages.task: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
hints: The Owl Totem is hidden in a cave starting at [1350, 83, -1605]. At the end of the cave, you can fight a miniboss which will drop the totem.
▸ Tips
Bring a horse or use some other method of travelling quickly for this quest, as you will have to go back and forth between the camps many times.
The Eagle Tribe is almost directly east of the Owl Tribe, not south and further into the Mesa.

stages.task: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [1314, 91, -1660].

stages.title: Stage 3
stages.task: Meet with Geo & Tarek at [1311, 90, -1654].

stages.title: Stage 4
stages.task: Sneak into the highest room of the Rymek Mansion at [1179, 32, -1295].
hints: If you get too close to a guard, they will stun you and return you to the start.
Guards can be distracted with marked activites; they will move away and allow you to pass their original location.
Go up the small parkour to the right, enter through the door.
Turn right and go downstairs, fight the guard dog.
Use the small pathway to the left to smash the cake, then quickly return and continue upstairs.
Enter the small tunnel next to the closed mansion door, rip the carpet to distract the guard.
Go all the way upstairs, then push the crates. Jump down, and use the parkour to the left.
Smash the window and turn left, go up the stairway.
Take the pathway to the right, throw potatoes and return.
Pass through the door and go upstairs once more.
Take the journal and leave the mansion by breaking & climbing through the furnace.
When the Guard Coyote spawns, a notice will appear.
Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...
After taking the journal, you will have to quickly avoid the guards in the room and break the furnace to escape.
Talk to Geo and Tarek outside the mansion.
names: » Sneak into the highest room of the Rym

stages.title: Stage 5
stages.task: Bring the journal from the Rymek Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
hints: Enter the cart.

stages.title: Stage 6
stages.task: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [1314, 92, -1690].
hints: Seems like there's a meeting going on...
The bandits will then walk out of the meeting room.
Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...
names: » Look for the sceptre within the bandit

stages.title: Stage 7
stages.task: Search the broken cart at [1183, 78, -1857].
hints: Seems like that note might give you a clue...

stages.title: Stage 8
stages.task: Search the abandoned house at [1220, 78, -1873].
hints: The Scrawled Note reads: "... hid the sceptre in that nearby house just like you said, boss... no one'll think to look right by the trap!"
Grab the sceptre on the second floor of the house.
The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.
You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.

stages.task: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [1408, 97, -1824].
